Onboarding slider

.dr-slider · --bleed · .dr-slide · --floor · __art · .dr-pager · components/media.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

9:41

You order, a pro handles it

Pick a service and pay. A certified DRON operator does the flying — you never touch the drone.

A verified, insured operator

The moment you pay you see their name, photo and live position. Someone accountable is on the way.

What the drone does — and doesn't

It flies a set route, keeps its distance, and only records what your order needs. Brief low noise on take-off and landing; no filming of your neighbours.

Get started Skip
  1. 1.dr-slider--bleedThe scroll-snap row, 373.4 × 577.6, filling the main area's padding box so it stops exactly at the action bar's top edge. It is position: absolute; inset: 0, and the frame opts in through .dr-screen:has(.dr-slider--bleed) > .dr-main. The same :has() keeps the status bar, top bar and action bar above the art.
  2. 2.dr-slideOne slide, named Slide 1 of 3. Its text is padded 20 from each side, and the art takes a negative margin of exactly that, so the words keep their measure while the picture runs edge to edge.
  3. 3.dr-displayThe heading, 22/700, top-anchored 48 below the top of the content area.
  4. 4.dr-leadThe sub-line under the heading. No type class was made for slides.
  5. 5.dr-slide__artThe picture in what is left of the slide, with 32 of air above and below. object-fit: contain, never cover, so a real photograph or cutout is never cropped.
  6. 6.dr-pagerOne pager for the whole slider, under it. The lit dot is --color-action and the rest are --bg-muted. ui/kit.js moves .on as the user swipes, and this page runs no script.
  7. 7.dr-actionbarGet started, the primary, on top, and Skip, a secondary, under it, one per row. The primary is on top in every action bar (rev 290).

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Onboarding carousel.

When to use

The onboarding slider opens three screens: welcome, onboarding-client and onboarding-operator. It is the only place where a picture runs to the edge of the frame. It only works inside a screen shell, because the frame opts in. The specimens are drawn at the built 375 × 812, because the art takes whatever height the copy leaves. A shorter frame would show a different composition, not the same slide smaller. A slide whose picture has not been supplied keeps a --media ground and a mono label at 5.51:1, so it reads as picture pending. No artwork is invented to fill it.

Each slide answers one fear in one sentence pair. The heading names the outcome (You order, a pro handles it, Jobs come to you), and the sub-line gives the proof: certified, insured, live position, paid within 30 min (voice P1, P2). The privacy and noise fears are stated as facts, not reassurance. Skip is a secondary, not a tertiary or text button. A borderless action on the bottom edge reads as a caption. Get started is the one green control.

A verified operator

DRON assigns the nearest certified, insured operator. You don't choose or guess.

Track it live

See the operator's name, photo and live position the moment you pay.

A photo or report, every time

Get a photo or a report the moment it's done.

Get started Skip

onboarding-client: three slides on what happens after the client pays, each a heading and one sentence of proof, with a picture that is never cropped.

Don’t

Get startedSkip

Skip drawn as a borderless tertiary on the bottom edge. In the action bar every button is filled. Make it a secondary. Do not use --bleed or the slider anywhere outside these three screens. To show progress through steps that ask for input, use the pager or the progress rail.
